import java.util.*;
import java.math.*;
import java.util.concurrent.ThreadLocalRandom;

public class Main {
    private static final int MOD = 1_000_000_007;

    // ModInt class
    static class ModInt {
        int val;

        ModInt(long v) {
            if (v < 0) {
                v = v % MOD + MOD;
            }
            if (v >= MOD) {
                v %= MOD;
            }
            val = (int) v;
        }

        ModInt(int v) {
            this((long) v);
        }

        static int modInverse(int a, int m) {
            int g = m, r = a, x = 0, y = 1;
            while (r != 0) {
                int q = g / r;
                g %= r;
                int tmp = g; g = r; r = tmp;
                x -= q * y;
                tmp = x; x = y; y = tmp;
            }
            if (x < 0) x += m;
            return x;
        }

        ModInt add(ModInt other) {
            long res = (long) val + other.val;
            if (res >= MOD) res -= MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt sub(ModInt other) {
            long res = (long) val - other.val;
            if (res < 0) res += MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt mul(ModInt other) {
            long res = (long) val * other.val % MOD;
            return new ModInt(res);
        }

        ModInt div(ModInt other) {
            return this.mul(other.inv());
        }

        ModInt inv() {
            return new ModInt(modInverse(val, MOD));
        }

        ModInt pow(long p) {
            ModInt a = this;
            ModInt result = new ModInt(1);
            while (p > 0) {
                if ((p & 1) == 1)
                    result = result.mul(a);
                a = a.mul(a);
                p >>= 1;
            }
            return result;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Integer.toString(val);
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            ModInt modInt = (ModInt) o;
            return val == modInt.val;
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return val;
        }
    }

    // Custom hash for Long keys
    static class LongKey {
        final long value;

        LongKey(long value) {
            this.value = value;
        }

        private static long splitmix64(long x) {
            x += 0x9e3779b97f4a7c15L;
            x = (x ^ (x >>> 30)) * 0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9L;
            x = (x ^ (x >>> 27)) * 0x94d049bb133111ebL;
            return x ^ (x >>> 31);
        }

        private static final long FIXED_RANDOM = splitmix64(
            System.nanoTime() * (ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextLong() | 1L));

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            long h = splitmix64(value ^ FIXED_RANDOM);
            return (int) (h ^ (h >>> 32));
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (this == o) return true;
            if (o == null || getClass() != o.getClass()) return false;
            LongKey longKey = (LongKey) o;
            return value == longKey.value;
        }

        @Override
        public String toString() {
            return Long.toString(value);
        }
    }

    private static final int N_MAX = 10;
    private static ModInt[][] probability;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int N = sc.nextInt();
        probability = new ModInt[N][N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                int p = sc.nextInt();
                probability[i][j] = new ModInt(p).div(new ModInt(100));
            }
        }

        ArrayList<ArrayList<Integer>> masksWithCount = new ArrayList<>(N + 1);
        for (int k = 0; k <= N; k++) {
            masksWithCount.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        int[] lookup = new int[1 << N];
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << N); mask++) {
            int count = Integer.bitCount(mask);
            lookup[mask] = masksWithCount.get(count).size();
            masksWithCount.get(count).add(mask);
        }

        HashMap<LongKey, ModInt> possibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
        possibleMasks.put(new LongKey(1L << lookup[0]), new ModInt(1));

        for (int left = 0; left < N; left++) {
            HashMap<LongKey, ModInt> newPossibleMasks = new HashMap<>();
            ModInt[] products = new ModInt[1 << N];
            Arrays.fill(products, new ModInt(1));
            for (int current = 0; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                ModInt prod = new ModInt(1);
                for (int right = 0; right < N; right++) {
                    if (((current >> right) & 1) == 1) {
                        prod = prod.mul(probability[left][right]);
                    } else {
                        prod = prod.mul(new ModInt(1).sub(probability[left][right]));
                    }
                }
                products[current] = prod;
            }

            long[] newBits = new long[N];
            long[] newPossible = new long[1 << N];

            for (HashMap.Entry<LongKey, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
                long possible = entry.getKey().value;
                ModInt prob = entry.getValue();
                Arrays.fill(newBits, 0L);
                for (int mask : masksWithCount.get(left)) {
                    if (((possible >> lookup[mask]) & 1) == 1) {
                        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                            if (((mask >> i) & 1) == 0) {
                                int newMask = mask | (1 << i);
                                newBits[i] |= (1L << lookup[newMask]);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
                newPossible[0] = 0L;
                for (int current = 1; current < (1 << N); current++) {
                    int lsb = Integer.numberOfTrailingZeros(current);
                    newPossible[current] = newPossible[current & (current - 1)] | newBits[lsb];
                    LongKey key = new LongKey(newPossible[current]);
                    ModInt add = prob.mul(products[current]);
                    newPossibleMasks.merge(key, add, (a, b) -> a.add(b));
                }
            }
            possibleMasks = newPossibleMasks;
            System.err.println(possibleMasks.size());
        }

        ModInt answer = new ModInt(0);
        int fullMask = (1 << N) - 1;
        for (HashMap.Entry<LongKey, ModInt> entry : possibleMasks.entrySet()) {
            if (((entry.getKey().value >> lookup[fullMask]) & 1) == 1) {
                answer = answer.add(entry.getValue());
            }
        }
        System.out.println(answer.val);
    }
}
